subject: Exec workshop — arrival windows & passenger allocations
messages:
From: Laura Chen <laura.chen@heliospharm.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-12T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Exec workshop — arrival windows & passenger allocations

Hi Sean,

Thanks again for hosting next week. Quick ask from our side: the C-suite prefers to arrive the evening before the 08:30 workshop start (Tuesday). Can you confirm the recommended arrival windows and whether Redwood will consolidate ground transfers for the four executives?

Attendees with flight constraints:
- Dr. Amir Patel (arrives from BOS) — prefers no red-eyes, earliest arrival by 18:30 local.
- Nina Torres, CFO (arrives from MEX) — needs visa check assistance at the airport and seat near aisle.
- Vanessa Lowe, Head of R&D (arrives from LHR) — prefers to fly premium economy if available.
- Tom Delgado, Head of Partnerships (arrives from DFW) — flexible on time.

If you can route us to a single airport shuttle pick-up and provide a passenger manifest for security clearance at the venue that would be ideal. We also have one assistant who may need a separate early check-in due to luggage.

We can share frequent traveler details once you confirm the PNRs. Appreciate the help — we want to avoid any last-minute scrambling.

Best,
Laura
Operations Manager
Helios Pharmaceuticals

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, JetSet Business Travel <ops@jetsetbt.com>
Cc: Laura Chen <laura.chen@heliospharm.com>
Date: 2026-10-12T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Exec workshop — arrival windows & passenger allocations

Thanks Laura — looping in Marissa and Karthik to finalize PNRs and ground logistics. JetSet, can you consolidate the four exec arrivals into a single shuttle block for Tuesday evening (pick-up window 18:30–20:00) at Terminal 3 arrivals and provide a short manifest (names, phones, flight numbers) to share with Helios security?

Operational asks from Redwood side:
- Please prioritize aisle seats for Nina Torres and premium economy for Vanessa if available within current fares.
- Add a standby contingency for Tom in case of a late arrival; we want one backup carrier option and a hotel hold.
- Confirm visa-assist desk info for Nina at arrival (we'll need the immigration lane contact).

Marissa — can you produce PNR stubs and a combined manifest? Karthik — please propose a single shuttle timing and an on-site contact for guest reception. I can approve any modest upgrade fees out of the events budget but need numbers.

Sean
Director, Customer Success | Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Date: 2026-10-12T13:24:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Exec workshop — arrival windows & passenger allocations

Sean — attaching PNR stubs and a provisional manifest. JetSet confirmed two PNRs under our corporate block and one separate booking for Tom (per his preference). Files attached: PNR_A23B4C.pdf (Amir & Assistant), PNR_D56E7F.pdf (Nina & Vanessa), shuttle_manifest.csv.

Quick notes:
- PNR A23B4C (Amir Patel): BOS-SFO, ETA 17:55, seat 12A (aisle requested, confirmed).
- PNR D56E7F (Nina Torres & Vanessa Lowe): MEX-SFO (Nina), LHR-SFO (Vanessa via JFK), both arriving approx 19:00–20:10. Vanessa's premium economy is ticketed; Nina's seat upgrade to aisle was requested and pending fare diff.
- Tom Delgado: DFW-SFO, arrives 20:30; we put him on standby for an earlier flight (20:00) and held a contingency room at the conference hotel until 23:00.

Attachments: see attachments list. I'll follow up with a PDF manifest for Helios security once JetSet confirms final seat allocations and seat-change fees.

Marissa Cole
Events & Travel Coordinator | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>, JetSet Business Travel <ops@jetsetbt.com>
Cc: Laura Chen <laura.chen@heliospharm.com>
Date: 2026-10-13T09:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Exec workshop — arrival windows & passenger allocations

Thanks team — a few operational suggestions from security/logistics:

1) Shuttle timing: schedule two mini-bus runs — 18:30 pickup (for earliest flights) and 19:45 pickup (for late arrivals). That gives us flexibility and a single consolidated drop at the conference hotel.
2) Security clearance: Helios to provide a short-form guest list (names + passport/ID numbers) by Monday 10/19 12:00 PT so we can pre-clear badges. Laura, can you confirm?
3) On-site contact: assign Redwood receptionist (Priya Natarajan) as the meet-and-greet; she'll have an expedited check-in packet.
4) Contingency: if Tom misses the 20:00 earlier flight, plan airport-to-hotel taxi with direct billing and keep the contingency room until 02:00 as fallback.

I'll update the event ops doc (TRV-1023) with these items. Once JetSet sends final PNRs and any upgrade fees, Sean can approve.

Karthik
Head of Events & Partnerships | Redwood Inference

Sean/Marissa/Karthik,

Confirming reservations and shuttle block per below:

- PNR A23B4C: Amir Patel (BOS-SFO) — confirmed, seat 12A, checked bag included. Attached PNR stub.
- PNR D56E7F: Nina Torres (MEX-SFO) seat 3C (aisle) confirmed after fee of $95; Vanessa Lowe upgraded to Premium Economy at $420 (voucher attached).
- Tom Delgado: standby cleared for 20:00 flight; contingency room extended to 02:00.
- Shuttle block: Mini-bus 1 (18:30 pickup, Terminal 3); Mini-bus 2 (19:45 pickup, Terminal 3). Driver Carlos Ruiz will meet guests at the Redwood signage in arrivals. Shuttle manifest attached (shuttle_manifest.csv).

Attachments: voucher_helios_upgrades.pdf, PNR_A23B4C.pdf, PNR_D56E7F.pdf, shuttle_manifest.csv

Regards,
